<thought>Search the template catalog using only the functional group that is formed in the forward reaction (the trimethylsilyl protecting group). This should return templates that create a TMS ether, which in retrosynthesis correspond to deprotecting it (breaking O‑Si and forming O‑H). Then retrieve the template details to get the mapped reaction SMILES and its ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["trimethylsilyl"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
